name: AWS RDS PostgreSQL DB Instance
documentation: An Amazon RDS managed database node provisioned for the payment system. It is configured with 20 GB of allocated storage, runs the PostgreSQL engine (version 15.3), and uses the db.t3.micro instance class. This node acts as the primary computational execution environment hosting the PostgreSQL system software and the payment_db database artifact. It is fully managed by AWS, abstracting the underlying hardware and OS.
